description: Launch an asynchronous LangGraph-powered therapy plan generation from session audio embeddings. Returns a therapy_session_id. Use vocametrix_get_therapy_status to poll progress, then vocametrix_get_therapy_result to retrieve the plan once complete (~30–120 seconds). BEFORE CALLING: Confirm that wav2vecOutput comes from vocametrix_classify_stuttering's summary_statistics — do not pass invented or placeholder data. Passing arbitrary values will produce a clinically meaningless therapy plan.

patientAnamnesis.description: Demographics, clinical history, and therapy background

name: vocametrix_generate_therapy_plan
